Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a chemoproteomic approach with photoaffinity labeling and click chemistry to enrich lipid-protein complexes via streptavidin pulldown, followed by TMT labeling and DDA LC-MS/MS. While the study focuses on sphingosine and cholesterol interactors, the proteomics assay itself is a standard AP-MS workflow with isobaric labeling.

scope: For enrichment of the lipid–protein complexes, streptavidin sepharose beads were used, and the proteins were eluted using 1% NP40, 0.4% SDS, and 2 mM biotin for 5 min at 98 °C.
Probes were either subjected to SDS-PAGE followed by western blot analysis or submitted to liquid chromatography followed by tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis.
Upon photocrosslinking and cell lysis, the protein-lipid complexes were clicked to biotin azide and enriched via Streptavidin-immunoprecipitation.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on proteins affinity-purified via streptavidin beads following cross-linking to lipid probes. While the probes were targeted to lysosomes, the material analyzed by MS was the resulting purified protein-lipid complexes, not a crude subcellular fraction.
